questions.passage: Agritourism is an increasingly popular form of travel that allows tourists to experience rural life, connect with nature, and learn about the agricultural industry. It provides tourists with an amazing experience and a fun educational opportunity they cannot have in cities. It also gives valuable insights into the history and culture of farming and the importance of sustainable agriculture. Most tourists spend time visiting farm stands, picking fruit, or feeding animals. Others may navigate a corn maze, stay on a farm, or help with farm chores. In addition to providing fun activities for tourists, agritourism has become a necessary means of survival for many small farms today. This is because agritourism activities can take place at times of the year when crops are not in season. By adding new business operations, farm operators are able to ensure a stable income regardless of the seasons.
